title: Gym reminders and gym messages can be switched on and still never arrive, with no warning
what: On the Reminders page the two gym switches warn only when all MettleUp notifications are off. Android lets a member, or a phone maker like OPPO or Xiaomi, turn off just one kind of notification (Messages from your gym, or gym reminders). Then the switch still says on, no warning shows, and nothing from the gym ever pops up. The app already reads that one kind's state, but only to add it to feedback messages.
expected: Under each switch, the page also checks that kind of notification and says 'Gym messages are turned off in your phone's settings' with the same way out.
how_often: whenever one notification kind is off
fix_line: Check the gym message and gym reminder kinds too, and show the same 'turn them on' row

title: The first team reply to a help question can arrive with no pop-up at all
what: When a help question went out with this phone's push address, the phone never pops up the first reply itself; it trusts the team's side to have done it. If that pop-up failed (address gone because the member left the gym or switched gym messages off, or the send failed and is never tried again), the member gets no pop-up for that reply, only the red dot the next time they open the app.
expected: The phone pops up the first reply too unless it knows the team's pop-up really arrived, or the team's side tells the phone when its pop-up failed.
fix_line: Let the phone pop up the first reply when it has not been told the team's pop-up arrived
